SproutTowerElderLecturesRivalText:
ELDER: You are in-
deed skilled as a trainer.

As promised, here
is your HM.

But let me say
this: You should

treat your
#MON better.

The way you battle
is far too harsh.

#MON are not
tools of war…
SproutTowerRivalOnlyCareAboutStrongText:
…
…Humph!

He claims to be
the ELDER but he's weak.

It stands to
reason.

I'd never lose to
fools who babble

about being nice
to #MON.

I only care about
strong #MON that can win.

I really couldn't
care less about weak #MON.
SageLiSeenText:
So good of you to
come here!

SPROUT TOWER is a
place of training.

People and #MON
test their bonds

to build a bright
future together.

I am the final
test.

Allow me to check
the ties between

your #MON and
you!
SageLiTakeThisFlashText:
You and your #-
MON should have

no problem using
this move.

Take this FLASH
HM.
SageLiFlashExplanationText:
FLASH illuminates
even the darkest of all places.

But to use it out
of battle, you

need the BADGE
from VIOLET's GYM.
SageLiAfterBattleText:
I hope you learn
and grow from your journey.
SageJinSeenText:
I train to find
enlightenment in #MON!
SageJinAfterBattleText:
As #MON grow
stronger, so does the trainer.

No, wait. As the
trainer grows

stronger, so do
the #MON.
SageTroySeenText:
Let me see how
much you trust your #MON.
SageTroyAfterBattleText:
It is not far to
the ELDER.
SageNealSeenText:
The ELDER's HM
lights even pitch- black darkness.
SageNealBeatenText:
It is my head that
is bright!
SageNealAfterBattleText:
Let there be light
on your journey.
SproutTower3FPaintingText:
It's a powerful
painting of a BELLSPROUT.
SproutTower3FStatueText:
A #MON statue…

It looks very
distinguished.
